_comment: Edit this file to change shop hours, fees, postcodes, contact info. Redeploy after editing. Do NOT put secrets here — they go in Cloudflare environment variables. Hours support cross-midnight by setting close > 24:00 (e.g. "25:00" means 01:00 next day).

business._comment_shortName: Short conversational form shown in headers and aria labels (e.g. 'Rico's — staff orders'). Defaults to tradingName when omitted.

_comment_seo: Search-engine extras used to build the landing page's JSON-LD Restaurant schema + social meta. cuisine + priceRange feed the structured data; addressRegion sharpens the location; sameAs links your social profiles to the business in Google (paste your Facebook / Instagram / TikTok URLs); description overrides the default meta/OG text. None of this changes the page visually — it's purely for search engines.

seo.description: Rico's Peri Peri — flame-grilled peri-peri chicken, pizza and burgers in York. Order online for collection or delivery.

_comment_theme: Brand colours used across all pages and the email templates. 'primary' is the dominant brand colour (currently red); 'primaryDark' and 'primaryDeep' are used for hover/active states - keep them progressively darker shades of primary. 'accent' is the secondary highlight (yellow). 'background' is the page wash, 'surface' is the panel/card background.

delivery._comment_mode: Delivery pricing model: 'outcode' (postcode allow-list) or 'radius' (distance bands from the shop). RICO'S USES RADIUS — the areaDescription/allowedOutcodes/feeByOutcode/blockedPrefixes below are kept for reference but IGNORED while mode is 'radius'.
delivery._comment_radius: Distance-based delivery measured by DRIVING distance from the shop postcode YO24 1AZ (geocoded free via postcodes.io). We estimate driving miles as straight-line miles × roadFactor, because a road route is rarely a straight line — roadFactor 1.3 is a typical UK city/suburban figure (a straight line runs ~20-30% shorter than the actual drive). Bands are checked smallest-first; a postcode gets the first band whose maxMiles (in DRIVING miles) it falls within; anything past the largest band = no delivery. If a real village still lands in the wrong band, nudge roadFactor (higher = treats everywhere as further) or a band's maxMiles and re-test on real postcodes.
delivery._comment_feePence: Default delivery fee in pence, used for any allowed outcode not given its own price in feeByOutcode below.
delivery._comment_minimumOrderPence: Minimum FOOD subtotal (after discount) for delivery, in pence. Set to £12.50 so the all-in minimum a delivery customer pays is £15.00 (£12.50 food + £2.00 delivery + £0.50 service).
delivery._comment_minimumIncludesFees: When true, the customer-facing minimum-order message shows the all-in figure (food + delivery + service) e.g. 'Minimum order £15.00' instead of the bare food subtotal. The underlying check is unchanged (still on the food subtotal).
delivery._comment_areaDescription: Free-text phrase used in error messages: 'we deliver {areaDescription} only'. Keep it natural so the surrounding text reads well.
delivery.areaDescription: to York and the surrounding villages
delivery._comment_postcodes: Allowed delivery outcodes. Covers inside the York ring road (YO1/10/23/24/30/31) PLUS YO26 — which holds the NW slice INSIDE the ring (Poppleton Rd / Acomb-Holgate edge, the addresses that were wrongly rejected) as well as the villages just outside it (Upper & Nether Poppleton). NOTE: outcodes are coarse — YO23 also reaches Copmanthorpe & Askham Bryan and YO26 also reaches Rufforth/Knapton; the kitchen can decline an address that's genuinely too far at acceptance time. For true distance-based pricing, switch delivery.mode to 'radius' (like Food Station).
delivery._comment_feeByOutcode: Per-outcode delivery fee in pence. The key is the postcode prefix (the bit before the space). Edit these to charge different prices for different areas. An outcode that's in allowedOutcodes but not listed here falls back to feePence. All set to 200 (£2.00) for now — update with the real per-area charges.
delivery._comment_blockedPrefixes: Block-list of too-far addresses that sit INSIDE an allowed outcode (e.g. Bilbrough/Askham Richard share YO23 with Copmanthorpe). Each entry matches the START of the space-free postcode, so it can be an outcode (YO23), a sector (YO233) or a full postcode (YO233PS) — as precise as you need. An address is delivered to only if its outcode is allowed AND it does NOT start with any of these. IMPORTANT: verify exact prefixes on crystalroof.co.uk before adding, so you don't accidentally block a real customer (Copmanthorpe & Askham Bryan also live in YO23 3).

_comment_serviceFee: Per-order service charge in pence, shown to the customer at checkout and added to the total. SPLIT: serviceFeePlatformPence is taken as the Stripe Connect application_fee (Lumin Labs' cut); the rest stays with the venue. On card orders the split is automatic; on cash orders the venue collects the whole charge and the platform reconciles its share separately.
_comment_serviceFeePlatform: Of serviceFeePence, the portion taken as the platform application_fee (Lumin Labs). The remainder stays with the shop — here a £1.00 charge = 50p platform + 50p shop.
_comment_stripe: Stripe Connect: this site's PaymentIntents are direct charges on the venue's connected account, with the platform service fee taken as the application fee. connectedAccountId is RICOS's LIVE Stripe Connect account. Requires the matching LIVE Stripe secrets in Cloudflare (STRIPE_SECRET_KEY / STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY / STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET).
_comment_pos: Till behaviour. selfServeDrinks:true hides the drink picker on the staff till — in-store the customer takes their own drink from the fridge, so staff don't choose one (meal/combo prices are unchanged; the drink is still included). The website keeps drink choices for online orders. requireOrderPin:false — staff take orders (walk-in/collection/delivery) without entering a per-order code; the manager/owner PIN on voids, refunds and cancellations is separate and still always required.

hours._comment: 24-hour format. Closes after midnight are written as 25:00 = 01:00 next day. lastOrderBeforeCloseMinutes is subtracted automatically for the cut-off.

ordering._comment_businessDayStartHour: Trading-day rollover hour (0–23, shop local time). 4 = the day's orders / takings / Z-report run 4am-to-4am, so late-night orders taken after midnight still count toward the day the shop opened. 0 = plain midnight-to-midnight. Harmless for shops that close before midnight (nothing to reclassify).

payments._comment_cvcThreshold: Order total (in pence) above which a customer paying with a saved card has to re-enter their CVV. Defends against account-takeover for higher-value orders. Set to 0 to never require CVC re-collection.

allergens.noticeAtCheckout: For allergens please contact the restaurant before ordering.
